result:
All seven days now stay on one line, spread evenly across the form's width. I checked screenshots at normal window size, with larger text, at 500px wide and at phone width (360px). All the tests pass on temporary copies of the project, and the real database and the login and signup templates are untouched.

**The cause:** the days only just fit with the old spacing and were allowed to wrap, so slightly wider text pushed Sun onto a second line. I couldn't reproduce your exact wrap, because the row fit on one line in my earlier screenshots. Wrapping is now switched off for this row, so it can't happen at normal desktop sizes.

**Phones (a small addition):** below 520px wide, there isn't room for the checkboxes and labels side by side. Each day's label now sits under its checkbox, so the days still fit on one line.

**Files changed:** `setup.html` (a class on the days row) and `style.css`.

**Separate issue, not changed:** at phone width, the top navigation bar runs off the screen and "Log out" gets cut off. This was already there, and I can fix it if you want the app to work well on phones.
